# Harvard Kennedy School

> Harvard Kennedy School offers comprehensive degree and professional learning programs in public policy, administration, and international development for aspiring and experienced leaders.

Harvard Kennedy School (HKS) is a leading institution for education and research in public policy and governance. The school provides multiple pathways for students to develop expertise in public leadership, from master's degrees to doctoral research and executive education programs.

## Key Topics

- Master in Public Policy (MPP)
- Master in Public Administration (MPA)
- Master in Public Administration in International Development (MPA/ID)
- Mid-Career Master in Public Administration (MC/MPA)
- PhD in Public Policy
- Public Policy
- Public Administration
- International Development
- Executive Education
- Public Leadership
- Professional Learning
- Degree Programs
- Doctoral Programs
- Combined Degrees
- Admissions

## Master's Programs

- [Master's Programs](https://www.hks.harvard.edu/educational-programs/masters-programs): Master's degree programs including MPP and MPA in International Development at HKS.
- [Master's Program Admissions](https://www.hks.harvard.edu/admissions-aid/masters-program-admissions): Master's program application process, admissions events, and financial aid information.

## Doctoral & Research Programs

- [Doctoral Programs](https://www.hks.harvard.edu/educational-programs/doctoral-programs): PhD in Public Policy and doctoral research programs through Harvard Kennedy School.

## Educational Programs Overview

- [Educational Programs](https://www.hks.harvard.edu/educational-programs): Overview of Harvard Kennedy School's degree, executive, and professional learning programs.

## Online Learning & Professional Development

- [Harvard Online Courses featuring Harvard Kennedy School Experts](https://www.hks.harvard.edu/educational-programs/harvard-online-courses-featuring-harvard-kennedy-school-experts): Online courses from Harvard Kennedy School faculty for professional development and lifelong learning.
